items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: And Cook hired me to play. So I went out there and worked from 8 to 12.

ctx.x: Give them a job again. You went there in 25. What did you do when you got to Chicago? Had you ever played in Chicago before that? No.

Soon I arrived there. I went out. They arrived on a Sunday night. And I went to the entertainer and the Howard Dixon band was playing. I know they were playing trombone, huh? Yeah. And I walked in El Nong and I see the dude raised by them and said, I had a kid. And they had a break. They all came to the table and talked to me. I met Carl and all the boys and they insisted on me playing the numbers with them. And stuff with and asked me to play and I went to play. And Cook hired me to play. So I went out there and…
